name: RSS 订阅
description: 为站点提供订阅地址，读者用 RSS 阅读器即可自动获取最新文章。
author: RiceNote

description.zh-CN: 订阅地址为 /feed.xml。修改后需重启服务生效。
description.en: The feed is served at /feed.xml. A restart is required after changes.

description.zh-CN: 关闭后订阅地址不再可访问
description.en: When disabled the feed address stops responding

description.zh-CN: 最多输出多少篇最新文章
description.en: How many recent posts are published in the feed

description.zh-CN: 开启后订阅里包含文章全文，关闭则只包含摘要
description.en: Include the whole article; when off only the excerpt is included

description.zh-CN: 阅读器与浏览器缓存订阅结果的时间，设为 0 表示不缓存
description.en: How long readers and browsers may cache the feed; 0 disables caching
